column1: # Runner catalog coverage for record files
# Generated in RecordCatalogCoverageTests from the lexicon entry, notebook record and list item schemas.
# The Example* fields are project-local custom fields: one of each type a kind writes (an owned StText among them), a Boolean no kind writes, and a date the schema omits.
# One row per reachable concrete schema class, record field key and verb.
# Covered rows are subject to the placement, owner, child and shape in the Runner declarations.
# A Covered row marked written-by-input or written-by-output is written by that rule-formula key, not under its own key.
# Non-authorable fields cite their classification in manifest/liblcm-inventory.tsv.
# LexiconEditReferenceSets require a Lexicon Edit detail slice in manifest/fieldworks-labels.tsv.
# CoveredNotLowered rows have a Runner kind that record import does not author; the reason column says why:
#   bespoke-payload: the kind's payload carries more than the verb and field (digests, paragraph keys, a census), so only its own composer authors it
#   create-composer: the create kind takes its own payload (morph type, reference, forms), which only its composer authors
#   delete-composer: the delete takes a payload only its own kind builds (a child id or none, by kind), and only the sense delete is authored
# LexiconEditReferenceSets rows are uncovered, and the last column says why:
#   append-only-kind: the add kind appends to the end of the sequence and takes no placement, so an insert elsewhere is refused
#   no-kind-built: no operation kind writes this edit of the field
